Docker.NotInstalled: Docker is not installed. Install Docker Desktop or Docker Engine (or set FM_DOCKER to the docker program), then open this again.
Docker.NotRunning: Docker is not running: start Docker Desktop (or the docker service), then try again.
Docker.ContainerStopped: The container is not running: start it (docker start {0}) to work with its files.
Docker.NoShell: The container has no shell (sh), so its files cannot be listed.
Docker.MoveBetween: Moving between containers is done by copying.
Docker.MadeWithDocker: Containers are made and removed with docker itself.
